finding: The first bargain is strongest when live observation and Scholar doctrine constrain each other, while the dragon seeks voluntary recognition of reciprocal obligation rather than mere possession.

local_discoveries.finding: The Spotter and Scholar become jointly useful when his live behavioral reading opens a path and her doctrine catches lethal category errors.

forward_consequences.statement: A first bargain framed as reciprocal obligation gives later human institutions something concrete to dispute about dragon gifts and obligations.

branch_updates.reason: The explicit dead-protocol challenge shows correct ritual can preserve safety briefly but cannot discover the actual bargain.
The explicit reckless-improvisation challenge shows observation without Scholar constraints creates lethal category errors.
